Truman Capote was born Truman Streckfus Persons in 1924. His mother was Lillie Mae Faulk, and his biological father was Archie Persons. When his mother remarried Joseph Capote, Truman was adopted and took the surname Capote.

- Agents 2, 3, and 4 all answered "Persons" with high confidence (0.92-0.95)

The consensus among the majority of agents is "Persons," which aligns with the historical fact that Truman Capote's birth name was Truman Streckfus Persons.
